description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the composition of a dataset by source/type, with a legend on the right and numeric value labels placed inside the larger slices. It shows six slices: a large yellow slice labeled 45,387 (roughly about one-third of the ring), a green slice labeled 43,000 (also about one-third), a blue slice labeled 30,000 (about one-quarter), an orange slice labeled 23,108 (around one-fifth), plus two very thin slivers near the top in purple (labeled in the legend as “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)”) and a small orange-toned sliver (labeled “Moroccan Names”), both appearing to be well under a few percent each and without visible numeric labels. The legend maps colors to labels including Moroccan Names (orange), Semantic Categories (purple), Syntactic Roles (orange-brown), an unlabeled gray legend entry, Extra + Augmented Data (blue), and Pending Translations (green); no slices are exploded, though the chart uses a 3D/shadowed rendering and the slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segments around the ring with the smallest slivers grouped near the top.
